create_inventory: create an Inventory instance to manage item stacks keyed by IDM
add_item_stack: add an item stack node with a given IDM and count to the inventory
remove_item_stack: remove an item stack from the inventory by its IDM and memid
get_idm_from_memid: look up the IDM associated with a given memid in the inventory
get_item_stack_count_from_memid: get the count of an item stack by its memid in the inventory
